Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Charles Mingus was “from Los Angeles, California,” despite prior results showing he was born in Nogales, Arizona. This misinterpretation of “from” redirected the plan to use California/Los Angeles (and thus a Los Angeles/Long Beach 1993 race) instead of Arizona/Phoenix, which would lead to the wrong race and winner instead of the correct Phoenix 1993 winner, Mario Andretti.
